changes.text: Learn your next points right on the next point’s card. It asks first, and says when they’re learned.
The build you follow is tagged, and with dual spec each spec’s build is.
Problem reports are listed at login, and /jsal reports clears them.
Back after dying, it knows your Well Fed is gone.
The pal nearer the front is drawn in front.
The game no longer lets addons read your layer.
